question: Where can I get a list of landfills and waste treatment facilities in the United States, with location, type, capacity, operator and status?

answer.summary: EPA publishes separate national lists: LMOP for MSW landfills (2,641 with coordinates, operator, open/closed status and design capacity in short tons; file of September 2024), GHGRP Subpart HH for larger landfills (capacity in metric tons, open/closed per year; 1,125 in 2023), and RCRAInfo for hazardous waste treatment, storage and disposal facilities (636 operating TSDFs typed by process, no capacity or operator in the ECHO download). Non-hazardous treatment sites (transfer, composting, processing) are in state systems such as California's SWIS.
main_caveats: No single national list: MSW landfills (LMOP, GHGRP), hazardous TSDFs (RCRAInfo) and other solid waste facilities (states) are separate universes.
Capacity units differ: LMOP short tons vs GHGRP metric tons (Sunshine Canyon 114,148,537 short t vs 103,536,088.2 metric t); design capacity is not annual throughput.
LMOP is not exhaustive and its newest file is September 2024; GHGRP latest year on Envirofacts is 2023 and covers only larger landfills.
RCRAInfo rows are sites (handler IDs); operating TSDF status summarises units; capacities and operators need the RCRAInfo permitting/handler modules.
Operator names differ by source: EPA lists parent companies (Republic Services, Inc.), California SWIS the permitted entity (Browning-Ferris Industries of California, Inc.).
answer.confidence_reason: EPA LMOP, GHGRP and ECHO RCRAInfo were downloaded/queried and cross-checked on one landfill; non-hazardous treatment facilities and TSDF capacities were not reached nationally.

attributes.note: Coordinates per MSW landfill (LMOP 2,323 of 2,641), per GHGRP facility and per hazardous TSDF (626 of 636); state systems for other sites.
attributes.gap_note: National lists of non-hazardous treatment facilities (transfer stations, MRFs, composting, waste-to-energy) were not checked; only California SWIS sampled.

attributes.note: LMOP = MSW landfills; RCRA TSDF process codes L/I/B/S/T; SWIS activity categories (Disposal, Transfer/Processing, Composting).
attributes.gap_note: Industrial and C&D landfills and non-hazardous treatment nationally not checked.

attributes.note: Design capacity in short tons (LMOP, 1,347 landfills) and metric tons (GHGRP); SWIS has permitted capacity/throughput fields per activity.
attributes.gap_note: TSDF unit capacities are in RCRAInfo permitting tables on HWIP (JS app; CSV endpoints not reached); SWIS values not sampled for a permitted landfill.

attributes.note: LMOP operator organisation (2,016 of 2,641); SWIS operator per site; GHGRP gives parent company (owner) only.
attributes.gap_note: RCRAInfo owner/operator tables are not in the ECHO download; HWIP module downloads not reached.

attributes.note: Open/Closed (LMOP 2024; GHGRP per reporting year), operating TSDF units (RCRAInfo), operational vs regulatory status (SWIS).
attributes.gap_note: Status of non-hazardous treatment facilities outside California not checked; LMOP status dates from September 2024.

how_to_use.example_result: GHGRP ID 1003679, Landfill ID 286, 'Sunshine Canyon Landfill', CA, Sylmar, 34.323520000000002, -118.50294, Operator 'Republic Services, Inc.', Open, Design Capacity 114148537, Waste in Place 72985822 (2022), Acceptance 2458975 tpy (2022)
steps: Read sheet 'LMOP Database' (2,641 rows); 'Field Descriptions' sheet defines units.
Filter Current Landfill Status = Open for operating landfills.
Join GHGRP ID to GHGRP Subpart HH for later reporting years.
reading_traps: Design capacity is in short tons; GHGRP reports capacity in metric tons (Sunshine Canyon: 114,148,537 short t vs 103,536,088.2 metric t).
Design capacity is authorised/design volume converted to mass; annual acceptance is throughput, a different measure.
Status is as of the September 2024 file; 318 rows lack coordinates; 2 fall outside a US bounding box.
MSW landfills only: no hazardous, industrial, C&D or treatment facilities.

problems: Latest file on the live page is dated September 2024.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -r 17316600-93641824 -o fac_member.bin 'https://echo.epa.gov/files/echodownloads/rcra_downloads.zip'  # local entry of RCRA_FACILITIES.csv (76,325,148 bytes deflated), offsets from the zip central directory
how_to_use.example_result: 1,638,476 handler rows; 636 with an operating TSDF code. 'TXD008079527','INEOS ACETYLS CHEMICALS TEXAS CITY','TEXAS CITY','TX','29.38264','-94.893285', OPERATING_TSDF 'L-----'
steps: Download the zip (118,901,097 bytes) or range-read only RCRA_FACILITIES.csv.
Keep rows whose OPERATING_TSDF contains a letter (not '------').
Split by letter: S 570, T 291, L 68, B 56, I 22 facilities (a site can have several).
reading_traps: OPERATING_TSDF placeholder '------' fills all non-TSDF rows; filter on letters.
No operator field and no unit capacities in this download; capacities live in RCRAInfo permitting tables (HWIP).
Hazardous waste only; MSW landfills and non-hazardous treatment are outside RCRAInfo TSDF scope.

problems: Full zip exceeds 100 MB; only the RCRA_FACILITIES.csv member was fetched with HTTP Range requests.

evidence.quote: These sub-universes are: Land Disposal (L), Incinerator (I), Boiler/Industrial Furnace, a.k.a. BIF (B), Storage (S), Treatment (T), and Solid Waste Management (H).

how_to_use.example_result: Grid: 3,098 sites, e.g. {'ID': 4702, 'Name': 'Sunshine Canyon City/County Landfill', 'RegulatoryStatus': 'Permitted', 'SiteOperationalStatus': 'Active', 'SWISNumber': '19-AA-2000'}; summary page: Operator 'Browning-Ferris Industries of California, Inc.'
steps: Get the site list from the grid endpoint (ignores filters and returns all sites).
Bulk export with coordinates is a POST form on /SolidWaste/Site/DataExport (not submitted in this pass).
reading_traps: Regulatory status (permit tier) and operational status are separate fields; 'Permitted' does not mean active.
Capacity and throughput are permitted maxima per activity, not actual tonnage.
Operator may be a subsidiary legal entity (Sunshine Canyon: Browning-Ferris Industries of California, Inc.) while EPA lists the parent (Republic Services, Inc.).
Activity grid endpoints ignore the site id in the URL; use the HTML pages.

problems: Bulk export requires a POST form with an anti-forgery token; not used under the no-forms rule.

evidence.quote: Each of the files include the SWIS number, site name, regulatory status, operational status, latitude/longitude and other information based on the Site Data Export selected.
